newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in today's afternoon daily Le Monde, dated March 5.

-- Environment Minister Corinne Lepage calls on Prime Minister Alain Juppe to open new public enquiry before restarting Superphenix fast-breeder nuclear reactor and denounces pressure tactics of the nuclear lobby.
-- Albanian tanks sent to southern areas as population fears bloody repression.
-- Official report points up regional discrepancies in the quality of health care services and lack of any real nationwide policy.
-- Alcatel Alsthom overhauls joint bid with Dassault and Aerospatiale to take over Thomson-CSF.

-- French 1996 aerospace sales up 7.2 percent over 1995. Exports accounted for 58.1 billion of the 108.4 billion franc total and military sales declined for the sixth year in a row to barely over 40 percent of volume.
-- Utility supplier EDF posts 1.87 billion franc net profit for 1996.
